quality_reference: Native Platinum/HGSS DS battle sprites: silhouette readability, restrained palette, coherent front/back design, clean outline, and 80x80 framing.

entries.name: chesnaught_mega
entries.note: Front/back palette and design treatment diverge strongly; pair does not look like one finished DS asset set.

entries.name: chien_pao_mega
entries.note: Readable silhouette and matching concept, but front/back value and color treatment need harmonization.

entries.name: chimecho_mega
entries.note: Clear form and strong readability; back uses noticeably different warm palette, so minor palette correction needed.

entries.name: cinderace_mega
entries.note: Front and back use incompatible palettes and shading; needs matched-pair reconstruction.

entries.name: clefable_mega
entries.note: Good DS-scale silhouette and coherent form; back is much bluer/brighter than front.

entries.name: clefable_mega_y
entries.note: Concept and silhouette are consistent, but back is dramatically lighter; palette balance needs fixing.

entries.name: coalossal_mega
entries.note: Front is bright gold while back is near-black/red; likely source/palette mismatch rather than an intentional lighting shift.

entries.name: copperajah_mega
entries.note: Same form reads clearly from both angles; orange vs green/brown palette needs harmonization.

entries.name: corm
entries.note: Simple small evolution/form reads cleanly and front/back are coherent at DS scale.

entries.name: cormoth
entries.note: Strong silhouette, restrained palette, and coherent front/back presentation.

entries.name: cormoth_mega
entries.note: Good readable form; front/back palette differs enough to need a final matched-color pass.

entries.name: corviknight_mega
entries.note: Excellent silhouette and DS readability; back is more desaturated than front but easily correctable.

entries.name: crawdauntles
entries.note: Front is ice-blue/white while back is orange/purple; clear palette mismatch.

entries.name: crobat_mega
entries.note: Front and back color families are incompatible; requires source recovery or intentional palette remap.

entries.name: darkrai_mega
entries.note: Current asset is a placeholder/question-mark sprite, not a usable battle sprite.

entries.name: darkrai_nightmare
entries.note: Strong readable form and coherent design; front/back palette balance needs a small consistency pass.

entries.name: decidueye_hisuian_mega
entries.note: Front/back palette and costume treatment differ strongly; needs matched-pair correction.

entries.name: decidueye_mega
entries.note: Front is bright multicolor while back is near-monochrome dark; not approval-ready.

entries.name: dedelibird
entries.note: Form reads clearly and pair is recognizable; front/back saturation differs but is recoverable.

entries.name: delphox_battle_bond
entries.note: Front white/orange and back magenta/purple are too inconsistent for one finished form.

entries.name: delphox_mega
entries.note: Front and back palettes are radically different; matched source or palette reconstruction required.

entries.name: delphox_serena
entries.note: Same design reads from both sides, but the back is substantially darker/purpler than the front.

entries.name: dewgong_mega
entries.note: Readable and coherent design; front/back palette/value treatment needs final cleanup.

entries.name: dracovish_mega
entries.note: Front/back palette families are incompatible; requires matched-pair correction.

next_batch: Continue alphabetically; prioritize READY/POLISH forms for the first approval sheet and quarantine placeholder/mismatched pairs.
